# Full summary of results for the performance measures {#sec-appB}
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

source(here::here("code/table_script.R"))

```


```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| message: false

results15_00 %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    escape = FALSE,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Simulation results (N2 = 15, $\\gamma_{01}$ = 0.0)",
    col.names = c("", rep(c("Bias", "Cov", "SD"), times = 5))
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 1,
    "CD" = 3, "LD" = 3, "MI-R" = 3, "MI-a" = 3, "Bayes" = 3
  )) %>%
  pack_rows(index = c("MCAR" = 4, "MAR" = 4), latex_align = "c") %>%
  pack_rows(index = c(
    "ICC = 0.1" = 2, "ICC = 0.3" = 2,
    "ICC = 0.1" = 2, "ICC = 0.3" = 2
  )) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  landscape() %>%
  print()
```
